lead.headline: 31.8 behind; Barkley alone tonight
lead.deck: Gadsden's 0.0 and a 49ers D/ST that scored 1 turned a lead into a 1% chance.
lead.body: Oronde Gadsden caught none of his three targets and the 49ers D/ST scored 1 after allowing 30, with Nick Bosa out. Bloodsports trail JuiceJam 89.8 to 121.5. Saquon Barkley needs 31.8 tonight at Chicago, whose run defence ranks 25th in yards per carry allowed to backs, while JuiceJam's Eagles D/ST faces Case Keenum. The lineup was the projection lineup. Tuesday's run decides MarShawn Lloyd's seat and the Josh Downs add before claims process at 01:00 Wednesday.
